theorems.name: Submission.frt_weq_open_compact_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ p, IsCompact (K p)) ∧ (∀ p, K p ⊆ U) ∧ (∀ p, K p ⊆ interior (K (p + 1))) ∧ Monotone K ∧ ⋃ p, K p = U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
